name: Yuki Reiji
source:
He is well known in the Kabukicho area, and is the head of a detective agency highly respected by both the police and the yakuza.

No one has ever seen him angry since the agency opened.

His private life is shrouded in mystery, and his private room at the back of the agency is strictly off-limits.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/reiji]Official site[/url]]
